source-integrity.freshness: Q2 FY2027 primary financials plus Sep-28 CEO-transition evidence
source-integrity.sourceIndependence: primary SEC/issuer evidence separated from independent expectations context

company-underwriting.operatingFinancialTrajectory: Q2 FY2027 revenue $771.8M +30% YoY; Atlas +29%; GAAP operating income positive; RPO +91%; FY guidance raised; Q2 FCF $137.6M.
company-underwriting.balanceSheetRunwayDebtDilution: About $2.4B liquidity supports execution, while six-month SBC of about $286.8M remains a material per-share conversion risk.
company-underwriting.governanceCapitalAllocation: Abrupt CEO transition increases governance/execution uncertainty; the prior long-tenured CEO returned as interim leader and existing guidance was reaffirmed, so deterioration is not presumed.
company-underwriting.pricingPowerConcentration: Strong subscription/RPO growth and gross margin support value capture, while hyperscaler/native alternatives constrain pricing and substitution conclusions.
company-underwriting.thesis: MongoDB is converting broad developer adoption into strong growth, cash flow and contracted demand while retaining AI workload optionality; leadership transition and dilution constrain confidence.
company-underwriting.keyRisk: Leadership disruption, hyperscaler substitutes or high SBC prevent operating growth from converting proportionally into durable per-share value.
company-underwriting.nextCatalyst: Permanent CEO selection and subsequent Atlas/guidance execution.

thesisQuality.basis: 30% revenue growth, 91% RPO growth and broad Atlas/EA adoption support durable developer data-platform demand, tempered by strong substitutes.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Revenue +30%, GAAP operating income positive, Q2 FCF $137.6M, about $2.4B liquidity and raised guidance indicate strong operating momentum.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Strong growth is established but the active source set does not prove favorable valuation headroom; SBC and expectation sensitivity require a conservative weak-to-mixed value.

catalystScore.basis: Atlas execution, post-Investor-Day checkpoints and permanent CEO selection are identifiable catalysts, but leadership transition adds timing uncertainty.

governancePower.basis: Operating execution and liquidity are constructive, but an immediate CEO departure and ongoing permanent-successor search create material governance uncertainty despite experienced interim leadership.

alignment2036.basis: Operational databases are foundational to conventional and AI applications across industries, giving durable infrastructure relevance.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Atlas and Enterprise Advanced serve geographically diverse conventional and AI workloads using the same core data platform.

bottleneckControl.basis: Developer adoption and managed data services create switching friction, but hyperscalers and alternative databases limit control of the infrastructure bottleneck.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Demand spans conventional and AI workloads and multiple geographies, but usage-based consumption and leadership transition add scenario sensitivity.

substitutionResilience.basis: Document-model fit and developer ecosystem support persistence, while hyperscaler-native, relational and open-source alternatives remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Software delivery avoids physical supply-chain concentration and spans cloud/on-premise environments, though cloud infrastructure dependencies remain.

pricingPower.basis: Strong gross margin and subscription/RPO growth indicate meaningful value capture, but consumption sensitivity and competition limit a stronger conclusion.

riskEvidence.basis: CEO succession uncertainty adds to SBC dilution, hyperscaler/native competition, consumption variability and AI/valuation expectation sensitivity.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Fresh issuer/SEC financials and direct SEC leadership-transition disclosure establish current operating and governance facts; independent context exists, while valuation evidence remains weaker.

scoreRecord.thesis: MongoDB combines strong operating momentum with durable application-data relevance, but succession, substitution and dilution risks reduce confidence.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Leadership disruption or substitute databases weaken execution while SBC dilutes per-share conversion.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Permanent CEO selection and subsequent Atlas/guidance checkpoints.
